text:
carmen: quick follow-up from the RFC review  proposal for a lightweight capture/replay of allocator+eviction events to help repro fragmentation OOMs. thoughts?
ben: huge win for triage if overhead is low. privacy and tenant isolation are my top concerns.
priya: also want clarity on interaction with offload timing and kvcache touches. replaying allocs without cache events may be misleading.
kai: sketch: record events into a pre-allocated ring buffer: alloc(id,size,stackid), free(id), evict(evict_id,victim_id,reason), kvcache.touch(keyid), offload(start,end,latency). Two modes: sample (eg 1/1000) and full-capture.
carmen: sample default for production. full-capture only via tenant opt-in or short auto window on predicted-OOM. strip payloads and obfuscate pointers for multi-tenant safety.
ben: storage/infra: compress varints, rotate to S3, retention tiers: sample 30d, auto-oom 90d, manual until deletion. Need delete/audit controls for enterprise opt-out.
priya: for replay, we must snapshot runtime flags and commit sha with the trace. simulator will consume events and emulate allocator+evictor deterministically. otherwise drift will make repros useless.
kai: implement ring buffer as mmaped file with line-delimited JSON events so simple tools can parse traces. write path must avoid allocations: use pre-allocated write cursor and atomic seqnums.
carmen: acceptance criteria before rollout: reproduce at least 2 historical frag OOMs in sandbox using simulator, sample-mode overhead <1% p95 tail, privacy guardrails enforced.
ben: UX: CLI 'rtrace analyze <id> --simulate' that emits compact diagnostics: max-free-chunk-time-series, churn-rate, eviction-counts, hot-slab-ids.
priya: add capture metadata: {trace_id, mode, sample_rate, runtime_sha, service, tenant_id_masked}. keep tenant_id masked unless tenant opted in.
kai: perf prototype plan: debug build with prototype ring buffer, run microbench against aubench to measure overhead. will post numbers.
carmen: open questions: 1) policy for automatic full-capture windows (trigger thresholds/time), 2) legal/enterprise opt-out enforcement, 3) who can request manual captures.
ben: propose auto window: when resident > 85% of quota and eviction rate spikes > x, start 10s full-capture. ops can opt-in to longer windows.
priya: require tenant admin flag for manual capture and log audit event for every capture. enterprise opt-out should block auto-capture too.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: created branch template branch/feature/alloc-replay and CI perf job skeleton.
carmen: I'll draft short follow-up doc with ring-buffer schema and privacy checklist. assign owners: priya simulator/analysis, kai runtime capture, ben infra/storage, carmen rollout. ping if objections.
ben: no objections. leave internal codename only. :thumbsup:
